headline: Calls are made on each IPO's last day and lock at 2 pm. Jio and Paras close tomorrow (Fri 23 Oct); their calls lock at 2 pm then. Tonbo and Bonfiglioli list tomorrow (Fri 23 Oct).
benchmark_note: Anant never states a fixed GMP cut-off. In his ranking videos, A-category calls have carried about 15% GMP or more (German Green Steel was A at 15–17%), B sat around 6–15%, and C around 5%. Your 15% gate matches his pattern.

anant_said: Rated A. High-tech defence: thermal imaging, night vision, electro-optical systems, with international defence credentials.
Negatives: revenue fell 22% in FY26, working capital is stretched, Q1 FY27 was a loss, and P/E is above 75.
Do not decide on GMP alone. Watch whether the anchor book and HNI demand match the defence-sector buzz.
tonbo-imaging-india-ipo.risk_why: Huge GMP cushion and strong HNI demand, but the valuation is stretched and the latest quarter was a loss, so the GMP can swing.

anant_said: Rated A. Italian parent, high profitability, almost no debt (D/E 0.01), ROCE ~25%; renewables and automation exposure.
Negatives: the entire issue is OFS, it pays royalty to the parent, related-party spends are ~30%, and P/E 46 is toward the higher side.
Big issue (₹2,533 Cr): keep watching subscription until the last day.
bonfiglioli-transmissions-ipo.risk_why: GMP clears 15% but has been volatile; QIB was only 0.40× at the 2 pm lock, then finished at 120.78× by the close.

anant_said: Rated low B. ₹5,000 Cr+ issue with only ~10% GMP.
Revenue is growing 55% a year with blue-chip clients, but the net loss was ₹1,600 Cr in FY26 and 40% of revenue earns ~1% margin.
zetwerk-ipo.risk_why: Loss-making, GMP under 10%, and only 0.31× subscribed after two days.

anant_said: Rated B. 100+ patents, sells in 76 countries, PAT up 175% in FY26.
Negatives: P/E about 58, borrowings up from ₹175 Cr to ₹269 Cr, and little market buzz.
sahajanand-medical-technologies-ipo.risk_why: GMP around 6% and the issue was undersubscribed (0.83×) after two days.

anant_said: 22 Oct video '7 mistakes that get IPO applications rejected' (no new grade): expects at least 1 lakh Jio applications to be rejected. One application per PAN across all demats; PAN and demat details must match exactly; approve the UPI mandate and keep the money in the bank until allotment; bid at the upper price (cut-off); apply in the primary holder's name from your own bank account; anything after the cut-off time is rejected.
No A/B/C label yet. He calls the ~20% GMP 'healthy' and the IPO 'very interesting'.
21 Oct midday Telegram: 'Sudden selling in Jio Platforms in grey market. GMP down', alongside 'Market all round selling'. A caution, not a call to skip.

21 Oct short: fully subscribed in 15 minutes; GMP ~24%, the highest of its trend so far. Warns that many applications will be rejected: only one retail application per PAN (the Reliance shareholder quota is the only extra), approve the UPI mandate, and enter demat/bank details correctly.
21 Oct Telegram (day 1): 'JIO QIB 15700 CR 🔥' and 'Today it's about Jai Jio'.
19 Oct Telegram: anchor list out, 212 names (LIC, BlackRock, Fidelity, Govt of Singapore, HDFC/ICICI/SBI/Kotak MFs). He calls it 'overall a good quality anchor book'.

19 Oct video '10 things to know': a factual explainer, no grade. 100% fresh issue; ₹27,500 Cr (~91%) repays Reliance Jio Infocomm debt; P/E ~33 vs Airtel ~42; 53 Cr subscribers and ~60% of India's mobile data traffic.

Shareholder quota (₹2,500 Cr): if you held at least one Reliance share in any demat on your PAN on 14 Oct, you can file a second application there. He says it's allotted proportionately, not by lottery, so a bigger bid (up to just under ₹2L) gets more, and if money is limited he'd pick the shareholder quota over retail. Employees get ₹54 off.
jio-platforms-ipo.risk_why: Strong business, quality anchors and heavy day-1 QIB demand, but a ₹30,213 Cr issue is a lot of supply and the GMP already dipped midday on 21 Oct with the broader market.
jio-platforms-ipo.lots_note: A mega issue may give more than 1 lot to every applicant. If you're fine blocking more, apply up to the retail maximum (14 lots, ₹1,87,992); otherwise apply 1 lot.

anant_said: Not covered yet. Expect his ranking video before it closes on Fri 23 Oct.
paras-healthcare-ipo.risk_why: GMP has fallen to ~6–7%, well under the gate, and it made losses in FY24 and FY25 before turning profitable in FY26.

anant_said: Rated A ('interesting to watch'). No.2 fire-protection equipment maker, ROCE 40%; but the whole issue is OFS and it depends heavily on a few suppliers.
hd-fire-protect-ipo.condition: Closed 15 Oct, before the tracker started. If you applied, check allotment and use the listing-day plan.

anant_said: Rated C. ~5% GMP; risk of AI disruption, 85% of revenue from North America, top 5 customers bring 40%.
fusion-cx-ipo.condition: Closed 16 Oct. C-rated; nothing to do.

_you_format: Per IPO, add "you": {"applied": true, "allotted": true|false|null, "gain_inr": number|null} when the owner reports it.
_override_format: To veto on Anant's latest view, add "override": {"verdict": "SKIP", "reason": "..."}. Overrides can only force SKIP.
